verdict.rationale: OpenTofu has no graphical UI. Its entire surface is the documented CLI (plan, apply, test, import, -exclude, -out plan files) driven by code-defined configuration, so no capability is reserved for a UI and everything can be scripted or run by an agent. Missing for 10: no HTTP/OpenAPI-style programmatic API (all OpenAPI probes returned 404), no explicit first-party statement of interface parity, and no independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
